# WiX / MSI Gotchas

> Known WiX Toolset and Windows Installer (MSI) patterns that cause silent failures or hard-to-debug errors.

## Entries

- [Major upgrade wipes runtime-modified data files (config.json) despite NeverOverwrite](major-upgrade-config-wipe.md): RemoveExistingProducts scheduled early deletes the old product's runtime-modified config before the new install, orphaning the app; schedule afterInstallExecute + Permanent component. HIGH.
- [MSI ProductVersion limits differ from four-part executable versions](productversion-limits-and-upgrade-order.md): EXE versions allow fields that MSI rejects or ignores; use a bounded monotonic mapping and preserve application identity. HIGH.
- [MSI norestart does not preserve running applications](norestart-does-not-preserve-running-apps.md): Silent MSI upgrades can close active viewers through Restart Manager and custom cleanup despite no-reboot flags; remove both paths and separately prove full session continuity. HIGH.
- [Earlier cleanup can hide an ignored MSI action failure](earlier-cleanup-hides-ignored-msi-action-failure.md): Successful earlier cleanup can conceal an ignored custom-action failure; independently reseed exact owned resources before install, repair, and uninstall and verify effects. HIGH.
- [WiX v7 EULA check also blocks wix extension add](v7-eula-blocks-extension-add.md): WIX7015 fails every wix command, extension add included, and a 2>$null add with no exit check turns it into a misleading missing-extension error; pass -acceptEula wix7 on every invocation and check the exit code. HIGH.
- [A WiX fragment anchored only by FeatureRef is dropped silently](fragment-featureref-does-not-anchor.md): The linker follows outgoing references from the package, so a fragment whose only link is a FeatureRef back to it is discarded with its dialog, properties and components, and the build still succeeds; reference a ComponentGroup it defines and inspect the built MSI. HIGH.
